Options:
  --multi [=MAX]                    Allow multiple selections
  -m                                Allow multiple selections
  --exact                           Use exact matching
  --query STR                       Set the initial query
  -q STR                            Set the initial query
  --filter STR                      Filter without interactive UI
  -f STR                            Filter without interactive UI
  --height HEIGHT                   Set display height
  --layout LAYOUT                   Select display layout
  --bind BINDINGS                   Set key and event bindings as one argument
  --preview COMMAND                 Set a preview command as one argument
  --prompt STR                      Set prompt text
  --header STR                      Set header text
  --delimiter STR                   Set the field delimiter
  --nth RANGES                      Select fields for matching
  --read0                           Read NUL-separated records
  --print0                          Print NUL-separated records
